The '''Hakawa islands'''<ref name="Geonosis" /> were a chain of islands<ref name="CSWE" /> on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The islands were situated just south of the [[Algae Sward]] sea and were formed by the peaks of the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Seascape Mountains]]. The ocean that surrounded the islands was home to the [[Whaladon/Legends|whaladon]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of intelligent [[Cetacean/Legends|cetaceans]]. The Hakawa islands were also near the underwater [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aquarius]].<ref name="Geonosis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hakawa islands were first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2004]].<ref name="Geonosis" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' spelled the island chain as the "Hawaka islands."<ref name="CSWE" />
